verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub Marketplace listing for 'GitHub for Atlassian', which says it syncs development across GitHub and Jira. That points to an external-tracker integration in GitHub's ecosystem, but it is a partner app and its description centres on syncing rather than showing Jira tickets inside GitHub. missing for 10: documented viewing and managing of external tracker tickets within the GitHub UI, linking or opening external tickets from pull requests, first-party documentation of the integration's depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
